items.title: Is therapeutic exercise as a standalone intervention effective in reducing kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis with meta-regression.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 RCTs (854 participants) found that standalone exercise significantly reduced kinesiophobia in adults with chronic nonspecific low back pain (MD = -5.38; 95% CI -7.63 to -3.13; SMD = -1.03), exceeding the minimal clinically important difference, despite considerable heterogeneity (I² ≈ 94%) and low certainty of evidence.
items.curatedReason: 运动疗法对慢性非特异性腰痛患者的运动恐惧症有显著改善，且效应量超出了最小临床重要差异。但鉴于研究异质性高、证据确定性低，在临床实践中推广仍需谨慎。
items.titleZh: 独立运动疗法对慢性非特异性腰痛成人运动恐惧症的疗效：一项系统综述、荟萃分析及荟萃回归研究
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 8 项随机对照试验、854 名参与者的系统综述和荟萃分析显示，独立运动疗法能显著降低慢性非特异性腰痛患者的运动恐惧症（MD = -5.38; 95% CI -7.63 至 -3.13; SMD = -1.03），且超出了最小临床重要差异，但研究异质性高（I² ≈ 94%），证据确定性为低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Therapeutic exercise significantly reduces kinesiophobia in adults with chronic nonspecific low back pain, with an effect size exceeding the minimal clinically important difference. However, high heterogeneity and low certainty of evidence warrant caution when generalizing these findings to routine clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本系统综述和荟萃分析存在高度异质性（I² ≈ 94%），且证据确定性为低，限制了结果的普遍性和信心。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis shows high heterogeneity (I² ≈ 94%) and low certainty of evidence, limiting the generalizability and confidence in the results.

items.title: Load-dependent Motor Cortical Activation Assessed by fNIRS Is Partially Preserved After Stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 12 stroke patients and 12 healthy controls found that stroke patients retained proportional load-related hemodynamic responses in the ipsilesional posterior parietal cortex during upper limb lifting tasks, unlike healthy subjects who showed responses in multiple motor-related cortical regions.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者在患侧顶叶皮层保留了负荷依赖性的血流动力学响应，这提示顶叶皮层在运动功能恢复中可能发挥代偿作用，可作为未来神经调控和康复策略的潜在靶点。
items.titleZh: fNIRS 评估的负荷依赖性运动皮层激活在卒中后部分保留
items.summaryZh: 一项对 12 名卒中患者和 12 名健康对照进行的横断面研究发现，卒中患者在上肢负重任务中，患侧顶叶皮层保留了负荷依赖性的血流动力学皮层激活，而健康受试者在多个运动相关皮层区域均有负荷依赖性响应。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stroke patients retain load-dependent hemodynamic responses in the ipsilesional posterior parietal cortex, suggesting a compensatory role for the PPC in motor recovery and highlighting it as a potential target for future neuromodulation and rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本（12 名卒中患者）横断面比较研究，且健康对照组使用的负荷范围与卒中组不同，限制了结果的普遍性和直接比较。
items.limitationEn: This is a small cross-sectional comparative study (12 stroke patients) with different load ranges used for healthy controls, limiting the generalizability and direct comparability of the results.

items.title: Adapted cardiac rehabilitation for individuals after stroke and transient ischaemic attack: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 19 studies (1951 participants) found that adapted cardiac rehabilitation after stroke and transient ischaemic attack (TIA) is safe, feasible, and acceptable, primarily for those with minimal or no disability, though effectiveness data remain limited.
items.curatedReason: 该综述确认了卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）后的心脏康复干预是安全、可行且可接受的。尽管有效性证据有限，但对于低至中度残疾的卒中患者，心脏康复模式可能是一个可行的康复路径。
items.titleZh: 卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作后个体化的心脏康复：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 19 项研究（1951 名参与者）的范围综述显示，卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）后个体化的心脏康复是安全、可行且可接受的，主要适用于残疾程度较轻的患者，但其有效性数据仍有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review confirms that cardiac rehabilitation interventions after stroke and TIA are safe, feasible, and acceptable. While effectiveness evidence is limited, cardiac rehab models may offer a viable rehabilitation pathway for stroke patients with minimal to moderate disability.
items.limitation: 本综述发现，关于纳入中度或重度卒中残疾患者的数据有限，且缺少有效性试验，限制了心脏康复对更广泛卒中人群的适用性。
items.limitationEn: This review found limited data on the inclusion of individuals with moderate or severe stroke-associated disability and a lack of effectiveness trials, restricting the applicability of cardiac rehabilitation to a broader stroke population.

items.title: [Correspondence] Making rehabilitation indicators disability-inclusive
items.summary: While global efforts like WHO Rehabilitation 2030 aim to strengthen rehabilitation systems and develop standardized indicators, there's a risk that these indicators might overlook structural and social inequalities in access to rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: WHO 的标准化康复指标对于加强康复系统至关重要，但我们应认识到，这些指标在实现“可衡量的独立和参与之路”时，可能无法完全解决康复服务中存在的结构性和社会不平等问题。
items.titleZh: 使康复指标具有残疾包容性
items.summaryZh: 有观点认为，全球加强康复系统的努力，特别是 WHO 的标准化康复指标，是改进康复服务的重要步骤，但其能否完全解决康复服务获取中的结构性不平等仍有待商榷。
items.curatedReasonEn: While WHO's standardized rehabilitation indicators are crucial for strengthening rehabilitation systems, we must recognize that these indicators may not fully address structural and social inequalities in access to rehabilitation services, even as they aim for a "measurable path to independence and participation."

items.title: [Correspondence] Physical activity and exercise training in patients with HFrEF
items.summary: A correspondence highlights the omission of guideline-recommended regular physical activity counseling and supervised exercise training in a recent Seminar on heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) and emphasizes their benefits when combined with pharmacotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 当前心衰指南已推荐规律体力活动和监督下的运动训练，但仍有研究文章忽视了这些非药物干预。我们应确保在 HFrEF 患者的诊断和管理中充分强调运动康复的益处。
items.titleZh: HFrEF 患者的体力活动和运动训练
items.summaryZh: 一封读者来信指出，在近期关于射血分数降低型心力衰竭（HFrEF）诊断和管理方法的研讨会中，遗漏了指南推荐的规律体力活动咨询和监督运动训练，并强调了这些干预与药物治疗结合的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current heart failure guidelines already recommend regular physical activity and supervised exercise training, yet some research still overlooks these non-pharmacological interventions. We should ensure that the benefits of exercise rehabilitation are adequately emphasized in the diagnosis and management of HFrEF patients.

items.title: The effect of multimodal sensory therapy in consciousness improvement in patients with acquired brain injury: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 studies (N=884) found that multimodal sensory therapy (MST) significantly improved consciousness levels (SMD, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.04-1.92) and increased the odds of coma emergence (OR, 9.85; 95% CI, 3.86-25.01) in adults with acquired brain injury-related disorders of consciousness.
items.curatedReason: 高异质性仍需谨慎，但这项系统综述和 Meta 分析提供了最强有力的证据：多模式感觉疗法能显著改善重度脑损伤患者的意识水平和从昏迷中苏醒的几率。对于这类患者，它应成为康复方案的基石。
items.titleZh: 多模式感觉疗法对获得性脑损伤患者意识改善的疗效：一项系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 18 项研究（N=884）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，多模式感觉疗法（MST）能显著改善获得性脑损伤所致意识障碍成年患者的意识水平（SMD, 1.48; 95% CI, 1.04-1.92）并增加从昏迷中苏醒的几率（OR, 9.85; 95% CI, 3.86-25.01）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Despite high heterogeneity, this systematic review and meta-analysis provides the strongest evidence yet: multimodal sensory therapy significantly improves consciousness levels and coma emergence rates in severe acquired brain injury. It should be a cornerstone of rehabilitation for these patients.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学局限性和高度异质性（I² 统计量高）限制了结果的确定性。
items.limitationEn: Methodological limitations and high heterogeneity (high I² statistics) across included studies limit the certainty of the results.

items.title: REmotely monitored, Mobile health-supported Multidomain Rehabilitation with High Intensity Interval Training for COVID-19 (REMM-HIIT-CoV): Trial Design and Rationale.
items.summary: This article describes the design and rationale for REMM-HIIT-CoV, a multicenter, single-blinded, attention-controlled RCT (N=140) evaluating a remotely monitored, mobile health-supported multidomain rehabilitation program incorporating high-intensity interval training for functional exercise capacity in community-dwelling adults post-COVID-19 hospitalization.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 的设计与原理值得关注。如果你在为 COVID-19 住院后的患者提供康复服务，远程、移动健康支持的多领域康复结合高强度间歇训练（HIIT）的方案，有望成为改善其功能锻炼能力的有效证据。
items.titleZh: COVID-19 远程监测、移动健康支持的多领域康复与高强度间歇训练（REMM-HIIT-CoV）：试验设计与原理
items.summaryZh: 本文描述了 REMM-HIIT-CoV 试验的设计和原理，这是一项多中心、单盲、对照随机试验（N=140），旨在评估远程监测、移动健康支持的多领域康复项目，结合高强度间歇训练，对 COVID-19 住院后社区居住成年人功能锻炼能力的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pre-registered protocol is noteworthy. If you're planning rehab for post-hospitalized COVID-19 patients, a remotely monitored, mobile health-supported multidomain rehabilitation program incorporating HIIT could offer clear guidance on improving functional exercise capacity, especially for community-dwelling adults.
items.limitation: 这是一项试验设计和原理报告，尚无临床结果数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a trial design and rationale report, with no clinical outcome data yet available.

items.title: Stroke survivors' experience using mechanically-assisted devices as a component of their upper limb motor rehabilitation program.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 11 stroke survivors explored their experiences using mechanically-assisted devices for upper limb motor rehabilitation, identifying five major themes including mastery of practice, device benefits/drawbacks, and the influence of people. Key takeaways emphasize the importance of intrinsic motivation, goal-oriented feedback, and clinician involvement.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了卒中幸存者使用上肢机械辅助设备进行高强度训练的体验。除了技术本身，患者的内在动机、目标导向反馈以及治疗师的有效沟通和支持，才是成功应用设备的关键。
items.titleZh: 卒中幸存者使用机械辅助设备作为上肢运动康复项目组成部分的体验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 11 名卒中幸存者的定性研究探讨了他们使用机械辅助设备进行上肢运动康复的体验，识别出五大主题，包括实践掌握、设备利弊以及人的影响。关键要点强调了内在动机、目标导向反馈和临床医师参与的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals stroke survivors' experiences with high-intensity upper limb training using mechanically-assisted devices. Beyond the technology itself, patient intrinsic motivation, goal-oriented feedback, and effective communication and support from therapists are crucial for successful device implementation.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本（N=11）定性研究，结果可能不具备广泛代表性，且仅限于特定类型的机械辅助设备。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample (N=11) qualitative study, so findings may not be widely representative and are limited to specific types of mechanically-assisted devices.

items.title:
Video-based education is non-inferior to in-person education in patients undergoing arthroscopic partial meniscectomy: a non-inferiority randomized controlled trial
							| Archives of Physiotherapy
items.summary: A non-inferiority RCT (n=166) found preoperative video-based education was non-inferior to postoperative in-person education for pain self-efficacy (PSEQ MD: -0.6, 1-sided 95% lower bound: -3.8 at T1) and led to reduced kinesiophobia (TSK) at 6 weeks post-surgery in patients undergoing arthroscopic partial meniscectomy.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证实了术前视频教育在膝关节镜部分半月板切除术患者中的非劣效性，甚至在运动恐惧方面优于术后现场教育。这意味着你可以利用视频教育提高效率，同时不牺牲疗效，甚至能更好地解决患者的心理障碍。
items.titleZh: 视频教育在关节镜部分半月板切除术患者中非劣效于现场教育：一项非劣效性随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项非劣效性随机对照试验（n=166）发现，对于关节镜部分半月板切除术患者，术前视频教育在疼痛自我效能（PSEQ 平均差：-0.6，单侧95%下限：-3.8，T1时）方面非劣效于术后现场教育，并在术后6周降低了运动恐惧（TSK）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms the non-inferiority of preoperative video-based education for patients undergoing arthroscopic partial meniscectomy, even outperforming postoperative in-person education in terms of kinesiophobia. This means you can leverage video education to enhance efficiency without sacrificing efficacy, and potentially better address patients' psychological barriers.
items.limitation: 本研究的随访期为6周，长期效果有待进一步观察。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up period for this study was 6 weeks, and long-term effects need further observation.

items.title: Effects of a multicomponent exercise programme including high-intensity interval training in institutionalised older adults with probable sarcopenia: a multicentre randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A multicenter RCT (n=92) found a 12-week multicomponent exercise program including HIIT significantly improved handgrip strength (mean difference: 9.11 [7.70 to 10.51]; p < 0.001) and physical performance (SPPB mean difference: 3.75 [2.93 to 4.56]; p < 0.001) in institutionalized older adults with probable sarcopenia, compared to a control group.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心 RCT 证实了包含 HIIT 的多组分运动计划能显著改善机构养老老年人（n=92）的握力（均值差 9.11）和身体表现。这明确提示你，即使是衰弱的老年人，HIIT 也可以是安全有效的干预手段，将其纳入老年康复处方。
items.titleZh: 包括高强度间歇训练的多组分运动计划对机构养老可能患肌少症老年人的影响：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验（n=92）发现，包含高强度间歇训练的12周多组分运动计划显著改善了机构养老可能患肌少症老年人的握力（均值差：9.11 [7.70至10.51]；p < 0.001）和身体表现（SPPB均值差：3.75 [2.93至4.56]；p < 0.001），优于对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter RCT confirms that a multicomponent exercise program including HIIT significantly improves handgrip strength (mean difference: 9.11) and physical performance in institutionalized older adults (n=92). This clearly indicates that HIIT can be a safe and effective intervention even for frail older adults, and should be incorporated into geriatric rehabilitation prescriptions.
items.limitation: 本研究未显示对肌肉量有显著改善，且为回顾性注册，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study did not show significant improvements in muscle mass and was retrospectively registered, which may introduce selection bias.

items.title: Optimising Exercise Prescription: A Meta-Analysis Examining the Dose Response of Exercise Duration on Cardiorespiratory Fitness Following HIIT and MICT
items.summary: A dose-response meta-analysis of 69 RCTs (n=2387) found HIIT elicited greater improvements in VO2max than MICT (d = 0.38, 95% CI 0.27–0.49, p < 0.001). HIIT showed a non-linear dose-response, with 80% of maximal effect achieved with ~11 min/session (95% CI 9.5–40.2).
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析量化了 HIIT 和 MICT 对心肺适能的剂量反应关系，表明 HIIT 在改善 VO2max 方面优于 MICT。更重要的是，HIIT 在约11分钟/节就能达到80%的最大效果，这意味着你可以更高效地为患者制定心肺康复计划。
items.titleZh: 优化运动处方：一项检查高强度间歇训练和中等强度持续训练后运动持续时间对心肺适能剂量反应的荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含69项随机对照试验（n=2387）的剂量反应荟萃分析发现，高强度间歇训练（HIIT）在改善最大摄氧量（VO2max）方面优于中等强度持续训练（MICT）（d = 0.38, 95% CI 0.27–0.49, p < 0.001）。HIIT呈现非线性剂量反应，约11分钟/节（95% CI 9.5–40.2）即可达到80%的最大效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: HIIT is indeed superior to MICT for improving cardiorespiratory fitness. Importantly, HIIT achieves 80% of its maximal effect with approximately 11 minutes per session, offering clear dose guidelines for optimizing and enhancing the efficiency of patient cardiorespiratory rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: HIIT的非线性剂量反应关系中，80%最大效果所需时间（~11分钟）的95%置信区间较宽（9.5–40.2分钟），提示估计值存在不确定性。
items.limitationEn: For the non-linear dose-response of HIIT, the 95% confidence interval for the duration needed to achieve 80% of the maximal effect (~11 minutes) is wide (9.5–40.2 minutes), indicating uncertainty in the estimate.

items.title: Perceptions and Experiences of Returning to Sport Following Myocardial Infarction: A Qualitative Study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored perceptions and experiences of 20 patients returning to sport after myocardial infarction, identifying challenges such as reconciling active identity with new reality, vulnerability, need for support, and navigating their own path.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了心肌梗死后患者重返运动的心理社会挑战（如恐惧和不确定性）和支持需求。将其纳入你的康复计划，特别关注患者的心理准备和个性化支持。
items.titleZh: 心肌梗死后重返运动的感知与体验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了20名心肌梗死后患者重返运动的感知与体验，识别出挑战包括调和积极身份与新现实、脆弱感、对强有力支持的需求以及自主探索路径。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the psychosocial challenges (e.g., fear and uncertainty) and support needs of patients returning to sport after myocardial infarction. Incorporate these insights into your rehabilitation plans, focusing on psychological readiness and tailored support.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Isolated anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction versus reconstruction with a lateral extra-articular procedure (LET or ALL reconstruction): a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A PRISMA-guided systematic review and meta-analysis of 20 comparative studies found that combined ACLR with a lateral extra-articular procedure significantly favored augmentation for IKDC (MD = 2.24, 95% CI: 0.40 to 4.07, p = 0.0168) and Lysholm (MD = 2.08, 95% CI: 0.37 to 3.79, p = 0.0171), but these differences became non-significant after Holm correction.
items.curatedReason: 对 ACLR 患者来说，在重建时增加外侧关节外手术（LET 或 ALLR）对 IKDC 和 Lysholm 评分虽有小幅益处，但在统计校正后不显著。这提示我们，辅助手术对患者报告结局的额外提升可能不如预期，你仍应将核心康复置于首位。
items.titleZh: 单纯前交叉韧带重建与联合外侧关节外手术（LET 或 ALL 重建）的比较：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项 PRISMA 指南下的系统综述和荟萃分析纳入20项比较研究，发现联合外侧关节外手术的 ACLR 对 IKDC (MD = 2.24, 95% CI: 0.40 to 4.07, p = 0.0168) 和 Lysholm (MD = 2.08, 95% CI: 0.37 to 3.79, p = 0.0171) 有显著益处，但在 Holm 校正后差异不显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: For ACLR patients, adding a lateral extra-articular procedure (LET or ALLR) shows a small, non-significant benefit in IKDC and Lysholm scores after statistical correction. This suggests that the incremental gains from adjunctive procedures on patient-reported outcomes might be less than anticipated; keep core rehabilitation paramount.
items.limitation: 纳入的比较性研究数量有限，且不同研究的异质性可能影响结果的可靠性。
items.limitationEn: The number of comparative studies included was limited, and heterogeneity across studies may affect the reliability of the results.

items.title: Patients' Mental Barriers in Rehabilitation after ACL Reconstruction: A Qualitative Interview Study.
items.summary: A qualitative interview study with nine patients 5-9 months post-ACLR found that psychological readiness is a dynamic process shaped by physical progress, emotional responses, support systems, and interactions with physical therapists.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了 ACLR 术后康复中患者的心理障碍，强调了物理治疗师在建立信任、管理恐惧方面的关键作用。在康复过程中，除了关注生理进展，你还要积极解决患者的心理层面需求。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后康复中的患者心理障碍：一项定性访谈研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对9名ACL重建术后5-9个月患者的定性访谈研究发现，心理准备是一个动态过程，受身体康复进展、情绪反应、支持系统以及与物理治疗师互动的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights patients' psychological barriers in ACLR rehabilitation, emphasizing the crucial role of physical therapists in building trust and managing fear. Beyond physical progress, actively address patients' psychological needs during recovery.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: How are biomechanical and psychosocial factors associated with injuries across one season in Swedish elite and sub-elite female soccer players?
items.summary: A prospective study followed 244 elite and sub-elite female soccer players over one season, finding higher hip strength was associated with a lower incidence of time-loss injuries in the dominant leg for players aged 16–19.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性研究量化了女性足球运动员受伤风险与生物力学和心理社会因素的关联，尤其是髋部力量与较低受伤发生率的关系。利用这些信息，你可以更精准地设计预防受伤的训练方案，尤其是在力量训练上。
items.titleZh: 瑞典精英和次精英女足球运动员一个赛季中生物力学和心理社会因素与损伤的关联？
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性研究追踪了244名精英和次精英女足球运动员一个赛季，发现在16-19岁运动员中，较高的髋部力量与优势腿停赛损伤的较低发生率相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective study quantifies the association between injury risk and biomechanical and psychosocial factors in female soccer players, particularly the link between higher hip strength and lower injury incidence. Use this information to design more precise injury prevention training programs, especially regarding strength training.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，不能确立因果关系。且受伤数据的收集依赖于每四周一次的报告，可能存在回忆偏差。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study and cannot establish causality. Injury data collection relied on four-weekly reports, which may be subject to recall bias.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Intensive Home-Based Motor Imagery Neurofeedback Training Using Mobile EEG to Assess Changes in Brain Activity and Motor Function in Stroke Survivors: A Multiple Baseline Design (MINTS Study Protocol)
items.summary: The MINTS study protocol outlines a prospective, single-group, multimodal intervention using an across-subjects multiple-baseline design to investigate intensive home-based motor imagery neurofeedback training with mobile EEG in 21 chronic stroke survivors.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究方案描述了在家中进行运动想象神经反馈训练的潜力，特别针对慢性卒中患者。如果结果积极，这可能为远程康复和神经可塑性干预提供新的思路，拓展你的治疗工具。
items.titleZh: 使用移动脑电图评估卒中幸存者脑活动和运动功能变化的强化居家运动想象神经反馈训练：一项多基线设计（MINTS 研究方案）
items.summaryZh: MINTS 研究方案描述了一项前瞻性、单组、多模式干预，采用跨受试者多基线设计，旨在调查21名慢性卒中幸存者在家中进行使用移动脑电图的强化运动想象神经反馈训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study protocol describes the potential of home-based motor imagery neurofeedback training for chronic stroke survivors. If positive, the results could offer new avenues for telerehabilitation and neuroplasticity interventions, expanding your therapeutic toolkit.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未提供实际研究结果。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol and does not yet provide actual research findings.

items.title: Ten-year outcomes of medical cannabis for chronic low back pain: opioid reduction, pain relief, and functional improvement in 1,000 patients
items.summary: A 10-year longitudinal observational study (n=1000) of cannabis-naive chronic low back pain patients found medical cannabis was associated with reductions in opioid use (MMEQ -89.8%), pain intensity (NRS -84.2%), and functional disability (ODI -30.4%), alongside polypharmacy reduction.
items.curatedReason: 这项长期观察研究提示医用大麻可能有助于慢性腰痛患者减少阿片类药物使用、缓解疼痛并改善功能。虽然是观察性数据，非随机对照，但它为你在多模式疼痛管理中讨论医用大麻的辅助角色提供了初步线索。
items.titleZh: 医用大麻治疗慢性腰痛的十年结局：1000名患者的阿片类药物减少、疼痛缓解和功能改善
items.summaryZh: 一项针对1000名首次使用大麻的慢性腰痛患者的十年纵向观察研究发现，医用大麻与阿片类药物使用量（MMEQ -89.8%）、疼痛强度（NRS -84.2%）和功能障碍（ODI -30.4%）的减少相关，同时多药共用情况也有所改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This long-term observational study suggests medical cannabis may help chronic low back pain patients reduce opioid use, alleviate pain, and improve function. While observational and not an RCT, it offers preliminary clues for discussing the ancillary role of medical cannabis in multimodal pain management.
items.limitation: 本研究为非对照观察性研究，存在显著的观察性偏差，无法建立因果关系，且受试者完成率较低（63.8%）。
items.limitationEn: This is an uncontrolled observational study with significant observational biases, unable to establish causality, and with a low completion rate (63.8%).

items.title: Regional alterations in bone microstructure, muscle, and fat of the knee following anterior cruciate ligament rupture: a laboratory study in rabbit model
items.summary: A laboratory study in rabbits (n=24) investigated temporal alterations in bone, muscle, and fat tissues after ACL transection, showing increased thigh fat (1.6±1.2%) and decreased muscle content (2.0±1.2%) at 3 weeks, and significantly lower bone mineral density in the knee at 6, 9, and 12 weeks post-ACLT.
items.curatedReason: 这项动物模型研究揭示了 ACL 断裂后膝关节骨微结构、肌肉和脂肪的区域性改变。尽管是兔模型，但其提示了 ACL 损伤后早期综合性组织退行性变，提醒你在康复早期需要关注多方面病理变化。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带断裂后膝关节骨微结构、肌肉和脂肪的区域性改变：一项兔模型的实验室研究
items.summaryZh: 一项兔子实验室研究（n=24）调查了前交叉韧带断裂后骨骼、肌肉和脂肪组织的时间性变化，显示术后3周大腿脂肪增加（1.6±1.2%）、肌肉含量减少（2.0±1.2%），并在术后6、9、12周膝关节骨矿物质密度显著降低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This animal model study reveals regional alterations in bone microstructure, muscle, and fat of the knee following ACL rupture. Although in a rabbit model, it suggests early comprehensive tissue degeneration post-ACL injury, reminding you to consider multi-faceted pathological changes in early rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项动物实验研究，其结果不能直接推广到人类临床实践。
items.limitationEn: This is an animal study, and its results cannot be directly extrapolated to human clinical practice.

items.title: Developing a sarcopenia identification model with eight machine learning algorithms
items.summary: A study developed and validated a sarcopenia identification model using eight machine learning algorithms, finding that a logistic regression model based on seven variables (BMI, FFM, age, sex, WHR, alcohol use, smoking) achieved excellent discrimination ability (internal AUC: 0.937; external AUC: 0.918).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究开发并验证了一个基于七个变量的逻辑回归模型，用于肌少症的低成本筛查。如果你的机构资源有限，可以考虑将其作为初步筛查工具，以识别需要进一步评估的高风险老年患者。
items.titleZh: 用八种机器学习算法开发肌少症识别模型
items.summaryZh: 一项研究使用八种机器学习算法开发并验证了肌少症识别模型，发现基于七个变量（BMI、FFM、年龄、性别、WHR、饮酒、吸烟）的逻辑回归模型实现了出色的辨别能力（内部 AUC：0.937；外部 AUC：0.918）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study developed and validated a logistic regression model based on seven variables for low-cost sarcopenia screening. If your facility has limited resources, consider using it as an initial screening tool to identify high-risk older patients requiring further assessment.
items.limitation: 该模型虽然经过内部和外部验证，但其预测能力仍需在更广泛的人群和临床环境中进行验证。
items.limitationEn: Although this model has undergone internal and external validation, its predictive power still requires validation in broader populations and clinical settings.

items.title: Novel Telerehabilitation Interventions for Stress Urinary Incontinence : A Systematic Review of Randomised Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of 13 RCTs found telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) to be a safe, feasible, and effective modality for stress urinary incontinence, offering comparable efficacy to active conventional care and superior outcomes to passive management, particularly in improving accessibility.
items.curatedReason: 对于压力性尿失禁患者，远程盆底肌训练（PFMT）与传统面对面治疗的效果相当，并且在可及性、依从性和症状改善方面优于被动管理。在考虑拓展服务可及性时，远程 PFMT 是一个有力的选项。
items.titleZh: 新型远程康复干预治疗压力性尿失禁：一项随机对照试验系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 13 项 RCT 的系统综述发现，通过远程康复进行的盆底肌训练（PFMT）对于压力性尿失禁患者安全、可行且有效，与传统主动治疗效果相当，并优于被动管理，尤其在改善可及性方面表现突出。
items.curatedReasonEn: For women with stress urinary incontinence, telerehabilitation-delivered pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT) shows comparable effectiveness to traditional in-person care and superior outcomes in accessibility, adherence, and symptom improvement compared to passive management. Consider telerehabilitation PFMT as a strong option for expanding access to care.
items.limitation: 本系统综述因纳入研究的异质性高，未能进行荟萃分析。
items.limitationEn: Due to substantial heterogeneity among included studies, this systematic review could not perform a meta-analysis.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation: a narrative review of clinical applications, proposed mechanisms, and implementation.
items.summary: A narrative review on music-based interventions in adult stroke rehabilitation found consistent evidence for rhythmic auditory stimulation for gait and selected music-supported upper-limb programs, while other applications like melodic intonation therapy for aphasia show potential but require more research on everyday transfer.
items.curatedReason: 音乐干预在卒中康复中显示出潜力，尤其在改善步态（节律性听觉刺激）和上肢功能（音乐辅助训练）方面证据较一致。但你需要注意干预的特异性，并结合患者偏好、卒中阶段和认知状况来制定方案。
items.titleZh: 成人卒中康复中的音乐干预：临床应用、机制和实施的叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于成人卒中康复中音乐干预的叙述性综述发现，节律性听觉刺激在步态方面、音乐辅助上肢训练在功能方面证据较为一致，而旋律语调疗法对失语症虽有潜力，但仍需更多研究验证其在日常交流中的转化效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Music-based interventions show potential in stroke rehabilitation, with consistent evidence for improving gait (rhythmic auditory stimulation) and upper-limb function (music-supported therapy). However, you need to consider the specificity of the intervention and tailor programs based on patient preference, stroke phase, and cognitive status.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，未进行正式的偏倚风险评估或定量汇总。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which did not undertake formal risk-of-bias assessment or quantitative pooling.

items.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of an Integrated Treatment of Vestibular Rehabilitation and Cognitive Behavior Therapy for Chronic Dizziness in a Community-Based Population: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=105) for chronic dizziness found that a group-based integrated vestibular rehabilitation and cognitive behavioral strategies (VR-CBT) program showed no statistically significant additional benefit over a single-session brief vestibular intervention (BI-VR) at 6 and 12 months for primary outcomes like dizziness-related handicap (DHI-N) and preferred gait speed.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性眩晕患者，综合性团体康复（VR-CBT）与简短前庭干预（BI-VR）在改善眩晕相关功能障碍和步态速度方面效果相似。这意味着简短干预可能足以达到与更复杂方案相近的临床效果，你应在临床实践中考虑其成本效益。
items.titleZh: 评估社区慢性眩晕患者前庭康复与认知行为疗法综合治疗的有效性：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对慢性眩晕患者的随机对照试验（n=105）发现，结合前庭康复和认知行为策略的团体干预（VR-CBT）在 6 个月和 12 个月时，对于眩晕相关功能障碍（DHI-N）和首选步速等主要结局，与单次简短前庭干预（BI-VR）相比，没有显示出统计学上的显著额外益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic dizziness patients, integrated group vestibular rehabilitation with cognitive behavioral strategies (VR-CBT) showed comparable improvements in dizziness-related handicap and gait speed to a brief single-session vestibular intervention (BI-VR). This suggests that a brief intervention might achieve similar clinical outcomes to more complex programs; you should consider its cost-effectiveness in practice.
items.limitation: 研究观察到两组在头部运动后眩晕强度方面存在差异，但其他主要和次要结局无显著差异，可能存在统计效力不足。
items.limitationEn: The study observed between-group differences in dizziness intensity after head movement, but no significant differences in other primary and secondary outcomes, suggesting potential underpowering.

items.title: Low-Level Laser Therapy Versus Mirror Therapy for Post-Stroke Complex Regional Pain Syndrome Type I: A Randomised Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=44) comparing low-level laser therapy (LLLT) and mirror therapy (MT) for post-stroke CRPS-I found LLLT demonstrated an early significant advantage at 4 weeks in pain intensity (P adj = 0.039) and sensorimotor recovery (P adj = 0.022), but no significant long-term between-group superiority was noted.
items.curatedReason: 对于卒中后复杂局部疼痛综合征 I 型（CRPS-I），低强度激光疗法（LLLT）在早期（4周）在疼痛和感觉运动恢复方面优于镜像疗法（MT）。然而，长期来看，两种疗法效果相似。早期干预时，LLLT 可作为你的优先选项，但长期仍需整合多种方法。
items.titleZh: 低强度激光疗法对比镜像疗法治疗卒中后复杂区域疼痛综合征 I 型：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=44）比较了低强度激光疗法（LLLT）和镜像疗法（MT）治疗卒中后复杂局部疼痛综合征 I 型（CRPS-I）的效果。研究发现，LLLT 在早期 4 周时在疼痛强度（P adj = 0.039）和感觉运动恢复（P adj = 0.022）方面表现出显著优势，但长期来看两组间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For post-stroke Complex Regional Pain Syndrome Type I (CRPS-I), Low-Level Laser Therapy (LLLT) showed an early advantage (4 weeks) over Mirror Therapy (MT) in pain and sensorimotor recovery. However, in the long run, both therapies achieved comparable outcomes. When intervening early, LLLT can be your priority option, but long-term care still requires integrating multiple approaches.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（44例），可能影响结果的泛化性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size (44 cases) may limit the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970-1990: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the development of Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970 to 1990, identifying the significance of the Repetitive Strain Injury epidemic, ineffective medical responses, barriers in conventional physiotherapy, and opportunities created by physiotherapists' adaptability and legislative reforms.
items.curatedReason: 这篇定性研究回顾了澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗在 1970-1990 年间的发展历程，揭示了其如何通过应对重复性劳损流行病和克服传统教育与立法障碍而演变。它展示了专业适应社会需求的关键作用。
items.titleZh: 1970-1990 年澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 1970 年至 1990 年间澳大利亚职业健康物理治疗的发展，揭示了重复性劳损流行病的重要性、传统医学反应的不足、传统物理治疗的局限，以及物理治疗师适应性与立法改革带来的机遇。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reviews the development of Australian Occupational Health Physiotherapy from 1970-1990, revealing how it evolved by responding to the repetitive strain injury epidemic and overcoming traditional educational and legislative barriers. It highlights the profession's critical role in adapting to societal needs.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性回顾，主要依赖访谈数据，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative review primarily relies on interview data, which may be subject to recall bias.

items.title: Low levels of physical activity and high amount of sedentary behavior in the acute phase after stroke.
items.summary: In 95 acute stroke patients (mean 71 ± 10 years), physical activity remained low and sedentary time high even after discharge, despite a slight increase in steps per day from 2844 to 4970 and a decrease in sedentary time from 22.7 to 21.1 hours/day post-discharge.
items.curatedReason: 卒中急性期患者即使出院后活动量有所增加，但整体体力活动水平仍较低，久坐时间依然很长。你需要警惕卒中患者出院后仍存在的体力活动不足问题，并在康复计划中持续强调动起来。
items.titleZh: 卒中急性期体力活动水平低且久坐行为多
items.summaryZh: 对 95 名急性期卒中患者（平均年龄 71 ± 10 岁）的观察研究显示，即使出院后每日步数从 2844 步增加到 4970 步，久坐时间从 22.7 小时减少到 21.1 小时，但其体力活动水平仍然较低，久坐时间依然较长。
items.curatedReasonEn: Even though physical activity increased slightly after discharge, patients in the acute phase after stroke still exhibit low levels of physical activity and high amounts of sedentary behavior. You need to be aware of the persistent physical inactivity post-discharge and continue to emphasize movement in rehabilitation plans.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，不能确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This observational study cannot establish causality.

items.title: Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): a double-blind, randomised, multicentre, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
items.summary: A phase 3 trial found mitapivat to be the first oral disease-modifying therapy for adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia, significantly reducing transfusion burden with a favorable benefit-risk profile.
items.curatedReason: Mitapivat 作为首个口服疾病修正疗法，显著降低了输血依赖型 α/β-地贫成人患者的输血负担，且耐受性良好。这为这类患者带来了新的治疗选择， PT 可将其纳入患者教育和多学科协作考量。
items.titleZh: Mitapivat 治疗输血依赖性 α-地贫或 β-地贫成人患者的疗效与安全性（ENERGIZE-T）：一项双盲、随机、多中心、安慰剂对照的 3 期试验
items.summaryZh: 一项 3 期试验显示，Mitapivat 是首个用于治疗输血依赖性 α-地贫或 β-地贫成人患者的口服疾病修正疗法，显著降低了输血负担，并具有良好的获益-风险比。
items.curatedReasonEn: Mitapivat, as the first oral disease-modifying therapy, significantly reduced transfusion burden in adults with transfusion-dependent α/β-thalassaemia and was well-tolerated. This offers a new treatment option for these patients, which PTs can incorporate into patient education and multidisciplinary collaboration.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注成人患者，且主要结局为输血负担。
items.limitationEn: The study focused only on adult patients, and the primary outcome was transfusion burden.

items.title: Fall-prevention education after achieving independent walking is associated with reduced subsequent fall risk in patients with stroke: a retrospective pre-post intervention study.
items.summary: A retrospective pre-post intervention study (1,437 stroke patients) found that standardized fall-prevention education delivered immediately after achieving independent walking was associated with a significantly lower adjusted hazard of the first fall (aHR: 0.58, 95% CI: 0.43-0.76, P<.001) and a lower fall incidence rate (IRR: 0.68, 95% CI: 0.51-0.90, P=.006).
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者在实现独立行走后立即接受标准化防跌倒教育，能够显著降低后续跌倒风险。将这一标准化教育流程纳入你的卒中康复末期方案，强化患者对风险的认知，以改善长期结局。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者在实现独立行走后接受防跌倒教育与后续跌倒风险降低相关：一项回顾性干预前后研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性干预前后研究（1,437 名卒中患者）发现，在实现独立行走后立即接受标准化防跌倒教育的患者，首次跌倒的调整风险显著降低（aHR: 0.58），跌倒发生率也更低（IRR: 0.68）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Standardized fall-prevention education delivered immediately after achieving independent walking in stroke patients significantly reduces subsequent fall risk. Integrate this standardized education process into your late-stage stroke rehabilitation protocols to enhance patient risk awareness and improve long-term outcomes.
items.limitation: 回顾性研究设计可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素，不能完全排除其他影响因素。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective study design may have selection bias and confounding factors, and cannot completely rule out other influencing factors.

items.title: The Added Value of Neural Mobilization Techniques to Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation in Patients With Adhesive Capsulitis: Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=56) found that combining neural mobilization techniques (NMTs) with proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) and conventional physical therapy led to statistically significant short-term improvements in pain, disability, and passive shoulder ROM in patients with adhesive capsulitis. However, only the 14.08° improvement in shoulder abduction approached the established MCID.
items.curatedReason: 虽然这项 RCT 显示神经松动术联合 PNF 能在统计学上改善肩周炎疼痛、功能障碍和 ROM，但除肩外展 ROM 外，其他结果均未达到临床最小重要差异 (MCID)。这意味着多数改善的临床意义有限。
items.titleZh: 神经松动术联合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术对肩周炎患者的附加价值：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验 (n=56) 显示，神经松动术联合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术 (PNF) 和常规物理治疗，能统计学显著地在短期内改善肩周炎患者的疼痛、功能障碍和肩关节被动活动度。但仅肩外展改善 14.08° 接近临床最小重要差异 (MCID)。
items.curatedReasonEn: While this RCT showed statistically significant improvements in pain, disability, and ROM for adhesive capsulitis with neural mobilization plus PNF, most outcomes, except shoulder abduction ROM, did not meet the minimal clinically important difference (MCID). This suggests limited clinical meaningfulness for most observed improvements.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小 (n=56)，随访时间仅 6 周，且多数结局指标的组间差异未达到临床最小重要差异 (MCID)，限制了结果的长期外推性与临床意义。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=56) and a short follow-up of only 6 weeks, and most outcome measures' between-group differences did not reach the MCID, limiting long-term generalizability and clinical significance.

items.title: Effects of High-Intensity Laser Therapy on Functional Outcomes and Spasticity-Related Pain in Subacute and Chronic Stroke Patients with Plantar Flexor Spasticity: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized sham-controlled trial (N=24) found high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) significantly reduced spasticity-related pain (P<0.001) and showed a covariate-adjusted gait speed benefit (0.089 m/s, 95% CI 0.003-0.176; P=0.043) in subacute/chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity, when combined with conventional rehabilitation.

items.titleZh: 高强度激光疗法对亚急性和慢性卒中患者足底屈肌痉挛引起的功能结局和痉挛相关疼痛的影响：一项随机假对照试验

items.curatedReasonEn: High-intensity laser therapy (HILT) is effective for pain relief as an adjunct in subacute and chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity. While it showed a statistical gait benefit, its clinical significance requires larger trials, so avoid prioritizing it as a primary gait intervention.
